verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·ḏā·wiḏ šim·‘āh Yah·weh ṣe·ḏeq haq·šî·ḇāh rin·nā·ṯî ha·’ă·zî·nāh ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî bə·lō śip̄·ṯê mir·māh
verses.literal: A prayer of David Hear O LORD my righteous plea listen to my cry Give ear to my prayer it comes from lips free of deceit
verses.literalPt: OUVE, SENHOR, a justiça; atende ao meu clamor; dá ouvidos à minha oração, que não é feita com lábios enganosos.

verses.original: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.literal: May my vindication come from Your presence may Your eyes see what is right
verses.literalPt: Saia a minha sentença de diante do teu rosto; atendam os teus olhos à razão.

verses.original: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י׀ פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־ תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־ יַעֲבָר־ פִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ḥan·tā lib·bî pā·qaḏ·tā lay·lāh ṣə·rap̄·ta·nî ḇal- tim·ṣā zam·mō·ṯî bal- ya·‘ă·ḇār- pî
verses.literal: You have tried my heart You have visited me in the night You have tested me and found no evil I have resolved not to sin with my mouth
verses.literalPt: Provaste o meu coração; visitaste-me de noite; examinaste-me, e nada achaste; propus que a minha boca não transgredirá.

verses.original: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃
verses.literal: As for the deeds of men by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao trato dos homens, pela palavra dos teus lábios me guardei das veredas do destruidor.

verses.original: תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל־ נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי׃
verses.literal: My steps have held to Your paths my feet have not slipped
verses.literalPt: Dirige os meus passos nos teus caminhos, para que as minhas pegadas não vacilem.

verses.original: אֲנִֽי־ קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־ תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־ אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî- qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā ḵî- ṯa·‘ă·nê·nî ’êl haṭ- ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā lî šə·ma‘ ’im·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: I call on You O God for You will answer me Incline Your ear to me hear my words
verses.literalPt: Eu te invoquei, ó Deus, pois me queres ouvir; inclina para mim os teus ouvidos, e escuta as minhas palavras.

verses.original: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hap̄·lêh ḥă·sā·ḏe·ḵā mō·wō·šî·a‘ ḥō·w·sîm mim·miṯ·qō·wm·mîm bî·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes
verses.literalPt: Faze maravilhosas as tuas beneficências, ó tu que livras aqueles que em ti confiam dos que se levantam contra a tua destra.

verses.original: שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־ עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rē·nî kə·’î·šō·wn baṯ- ‘ā·yin bə·ṣêl kə·nā·p̄e·ḵā tas·tî·rê·nî
verses.literal: Keep me as the apple of Your eye hide me in the shadow of Your wings
verses.literalPt: Guarda-me como à menina do olho; esconde-me debaixo da sombra das tuas asas,

verses.original: מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·nê rə·šā·‘îm zū šad·dū·nî ’ō·yə·ḇay bə·ne·p̄eš yaq·qî·p̄ū ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: from the wicked who assail me from my mortal enemies who surround me . . .
verses.literalPt: Dos ímpios que me oprimem, dos meus inimigos mortais que me andam cercando.

verses.literal: They have closed their callous hearts their mouths speak with arrogance
verses.literalPt: Na sua gordura se encerram, com a boca falam soberbamente.

verses.original: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סְבָבוּנִי עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: They have tracked us down and now surround us their eyes are set to cast us to the ground
verses.literalPt: Têm-nos cercado agora nossos passos; e baixaram os seus olhos para a terra;

verses.original: דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dim·yō·nōw kə·’ar·yêh yiḵ·sō·wp̄ liṭ·rō·wp̄ wə·ḵiḵ·p̄îr yō·šêḇ bə·mis·tā·rîm
verses.literal: like a lion greedy for prey like a young lion lurking in ambush
verses.literalPt: Parecem-se com o leão que deseja arrebatar a sua presa, e com o leãozinho que se põe em esconderijos.

verses.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh qad·də·māh p̄ā·nāw haḵ·rî·‘ê·hū pal·lə·ṭāh nap̄·šî mê·rā·šā‘ ḥar·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Arise O LORD confront them Bring them to their knees deliver me from the wicked by Your sword
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, SENHOR, detém-no, derriba-o, livra a minha alma do ímpio, com a tua espada;

verses.original: מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨׀ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וּצְפִינְךָ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mim·ṯîm yā·ḏə·ḵā Yah·weh mim·ṯîm mê·ḥe·leḏ ḥel·qām ba·ḥay·yîm ū·ṣə·p̄ī·nə·ḵå̄ tə·mal·lê ḇiṭ·nām yiś·bə·‘ū ḇā·nîm wə·hin·nî·ḥū yiṯ·rām lə·‘ō·wl·lê·hem
verses.literal: from such men O LORD by Your hand from men of the world whose portion is in this life May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons so they leave their abundance to their children
verses.literalPt: Dos homens com a tua mão, SENHOR, dos homens do mundo, cuja porção está nesta vida, e cujo ventre enches do teu tesouro oculto. Estão fartos de filhos e dão os seus sobejos às suas crianças.

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: As for me I will behold Your face in righteousness when I awake I will be satisfied in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, contemplarei a tua face na justiça; eu me satisfarei da tua semelhança quando acordar.
